text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000064 bills 99215 far above expectation, mostly on low-complexity patients, but only three documented 99215 claims exist, too few to confirm or rule out upcoding.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The claims pattern raises concern: 99215 share is elevated in every complexity band, including patients with no chronic conditions, and most 99215s go to 0-1 condition patients. Sampled examples include C0031707 (urinary infection code only), C0032123 (upper respiratory infection) and C0032149 (low back pain), where a high-complexity visit would be unusual. The documentation is too thin to judge. All three documented 99215 claims (e.g., C0031666) were supported at high MDM, but three charts cannot outweigh or confirm the billing pattern. Three of the notes claiming moderate-or-higher data review had no lab or test line on the claim, which is weak evidence that some notes may be templated or inflated rather than proof. A reviewer should first request charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed, such as C0031737, C0031940 and C0032261, and check whether the documented MDM and time reflect the actual encounter or appear cloned."}
